root_cause: checkout-api retains memory on every request; the heap grows until allocations fail with OutOfMemory errors.
evidence: metric:mem_mb grows steadily after the fault starts
log: 'heap usage ... approaching limit' warnings then OutOfMemory errors
metric:error_rate_percent rises once the heap limit is hit
recommended_remediation: Restart checkout-api to reclaim memory and roll back or fix the change that retains per-request objects.
risk_rationale: Restarting or rolling back a production service is high risk.
title: memory leak heap exhaustion (live)
